questions.title: EV Charging Station
questions.prompt:
Create a class `EVStation` in `EVStation.java`:
* **Private fields:** `String stationId`, `String city`, `int totalPorts`, `double pricePerKWh`.
* **Constructor 1:** `EVStation(String stationId, String city, int totalPorts, double pricePerKWh)`.
* **Constructor 2:** `EVStation(String stationId, String city)` which assigns `totalPorts = 4` and `pricePerKWh = 0.35`.
* **Getters and Setters:** For all four fields.
  * In `setTotalPorts(int totalPorts)`: Must have at least 1 port and at most 32. If `< 1`, set to `1`. If `> 32`, set to `32`.
  * In `setPricePerKWh(double price)`: If `< 0.05`, set to `0.05`.

questions.title: Drone Altitude Guard
questions.prompt:
Create an unchecked exception `CeilingExceededException` in `CeilingExceededException.java` that extends `RuntimeException` with a constructor taking `String message`.

In `DroneController.java`, implement:
`public static int climb(int currentAltitude, int delta, int maxCeiling) throws CeilingExceededException`
* If `delta <= 0`, throw `IllegalArgumentException` with message: `"Climb delta must be positive"`.
* If `currentAltitude + delta > maxCeiling`, throw `CeilingExceededException` with message:
  `"Ceiling violated: attempted <currentAltitude + delta>m, ceiling is <maxCeiling>m"`.
* Otherwise, return `currentAltitude + delta`.

Altitude: 90m
Ceiling violated: attempted 140m, ceiling is 120m

tests.description: delta = 0 throws IllegalArgumentException.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Negative Delta)
tests.description: delta = -10 throws IllegalArgumentException.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Unchecked Exception Verification)
tests.description: Verifies CeilingExceededException extends RuntimeException.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Starting at Ceiling)

questions.title: Fleet Carbon Footprint
questions.prompt:
Given base class `Vehicle` with method `double getEmissions()` and subclass `HybridVehicle` (which overrides `getEmissions()` applying a battery fuel offset), implement `FleetAnalyzer.java`:
* `public static double calculateTotalEmissions(Vehicle[] fleet)`:
  * Sums `getEmissions()` across all non-null vehicles.
  * If `fleet` is `null` or empty, return `0.0`.
* `public static int countZeroEmissionVehicles(Vehicle[] fleet)`:
  * Returns how many non-null vehicles have `getEmissions() <= 0.0`.
  * If `fleet` is `null`, return `0`.

*(The autograder provides `Vehicle` and `HybridVehicle`.)*

questions.title: Sensor Stream Min-Max
questions.prompt:
In `SensorDataReader.java`, write:
`public static double findSensorRange(String filename) throws FileNotFoundException`
* The file contains comma-separated reading lines: `SensorId,ReadingValue`
  Example: `TEMP-A,98.6`
* The first line is a header (`SensorId,ReadingValue`) and must be skipped.
* Find the maximum reading and the minimum reading among all rows.
* Return the range: `maxReading - minReading`.
* If the file has no data rows (only the header), return `0.0`.
* If the file does not exist, throw `FileNotFoundException`. Ensure resources are closed.

questions.title: Network Node Latency Rating
questions.prompt:
This question gives you a question-specific abstract class **and** a question-specific interface. Your class must extend one and implement the other.

Create an abstract class `NetworkNode` in `NetworkNode.java`:
* **Protected field:** `String hostname`.
* **Constructor:** `NetworkNode(String hostname)`.
* **Getter:** `getHostname()`.
* **Abstract method:** `public abstract int pingMs();` (the raw round-trip ping).

Create an interface `LatencyRated` in `LatencyRated.java`:
* Abstract method: `int latencyMs();` (the *effective* latency).
* Default method: `default boolean isSlow(int thresholdMs)`: returns `true` when `latencyMs() >= thresholdMs` (inclusive).
* Default method: `default char grade()`: `'A'` if `latencyMs() < 50`, `'B'` if `< 100`, `'C'` if `< 200`, otherwise `'F'`.

Create a class `EdgeServer` in `EdgeServer.java` that **extends `NetworkNode` and implements `LatencyRated`**:
* **Private fields:** `int basePingMs`, `int activeConnections`, `int capacity`.
* **Constructor:** `EdgeServer(String hostname, int basePingMs, int activeConnections, int capacity)` calling `super`.
* `pingMs()` returns `basePingMs` (the raw ping, unaffected by load).
* `latencyMs()`: returns `basePingMs` normally, but when `activeConnections` is **strictly greater** than `capacity`, congestion **doubles** the effective latency.

*Edge cases to think about (not in the sample): connections exactly equal to capacity do NOT congest; the grade boundaries are exclusive on the upper end (49→A, 50→B, 99→B, 100→C, 199→C, 200→F); congestion can push a node into a worse grade; `isSlow` is inclusive at the threshold.*
questions.expectedOutput:
Ping: 150ms
Latency: 150ms
Grade: C
Slow (>=100): true

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Under capacity: ping equals latency; grade and inclusive isSlow.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (At Capacity No Congestion)
tests.description: activeConnections == capacity does NOT double latency.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Over Capacity Doubles)
tests.description: activeConnections one over capacity doubles effective latency.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (isSlow Inclusive)
tests.description: isSlow is true at exactly the threshold, false just above it.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Congestion Lowers Grade)
tests.description: Congestion doubling can move a node to a worse grade.

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Polymorphic Ping)
tests.description: pingMs invoked through a NetworkNode reference.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Ping: 150ms
Latency: 150ms
Grade: C
Slow (>=100): true

graderCases.name: Sample run (under capacity, base latency + types)
At capacity (equal) does NOT congest
graderCases.body:
EdgeServer s = new EdgeServer("h",40,100,100);
eq(s.latencyMs(),40);

graderCases.name: Over capacity doubles latency
graderCases.body:
EdgeServer s = new EdgeServer("h",40,101,100);
eq(s.latencyMs(),80);

graderCases.name: isSlow is inclusive at threshold
Grade boundaries A/B/C/F
Congestion can drop the grade
Polymorphic ping through NetworkNode reference
graderCases.body:
NetworkNode n = new EdgeServer("h",33,0,100);
eq(n.pingMs(),33);

questions.title: Bank Loan Hierarchy
questions.prompt:
This question requires a question-specific abstract class **and** a question-specific interface. Every concrete loan must extend the class and implement the interface.

Create an abstract class `Loan` in `Loan.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `double principal`, `double annualInterestRate`.
* **Constructor:** `Loan(double principal, double annualInterestRate)`.
* **Abstract method:** `public abstract double calculateTotalRepayment(int years);`

Create an interface `Amortizable` in `Amortizable.java`:
* Abstract method: `double totalOwed(int years);`
* Default method: `default double monthlyPayment(int years)`: the total owed spread evenly over `years * 12` months. **If `years <= 0`, return `0.0`** (there are no scheduled payments — do not divide by zero).
* Default method: `default boolean isAffordable(int years, double monthlyBudget)`: returns `true` when `monthlyPayment(years) <= monthlyBudget`.

Create `PersonalLoan` in `PersonalLoan.java` **extending `Loan` and implementing `Amortizable`**:
* **Constructor:** `PersonalLoan(double principal, double annualInterestRate)`.
* `calculateTotalRepayment(int years)`: simple interest `principal + (principal * annualInterestRate * years)`.
* `totalOwed(int years)` must return the same value as `calculateTotalRepayment(years)`.

Create `MortgageLoan` in `MortgageLoan.java` **extending `Loan` and implementing `Amortizable`**:
* **Private field:** `double originationFee`.
* **Constructor:** `MortgageLoan(double principal, double annualInterestRate, double originationFee)` using `super`.
* `calculateTotalRepayment(int years)`: simple interest + `originationFee`; if `years >= 30`, subtract a `$1000.0` long-term closing discount.
* `totalOwed(int years)` must return the same value as `calculateTotalRepayment(years)`.

*Edge cases to think about (not in the sample): a 29-year mortgage gets no discount but exactly 30 does; `monthlyPayment(0)` must be `0.0` and never divide by zero; `isAffordable` is inclusive at the budget.*

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Personal simple interest and mortgage with 30-year discount.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (29-Year Mortgage)
tests.description: 29-year mortgage does NOT get the $1000 discount.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (30-Year Mortgage Boundary)
tests.description: Exactly 30 years applies $1000 discount.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Zero Years)
tests.description: Repayment at 0 years equals principal (plus fee for mortgage).

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Monthly Payment)
tests.description: monthlyPayment spreads total owed evenly over years*12 months.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Monthly Payment Zero Years)
tests.description: monthlyPayment(0) returns 0.0 without dividing by zero.

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Affordability Inclusive)
tests.description: isAffordable is inclusive: equal to budget is affordable, just above is not.

graderCases.name: Sample run (personal + 30yr mortgage discount + types)
29-year mortgage: no discount
graderCases.body:
MortgageLoan m = new MortgageLoan(200000.0,0.04,3000.0);
eqD(m.calculateTotalRepayment(29),200000.0 + 200000.0*0.04*29 + 3000.0);

graderCases.name: Exactly 30 years applies discount
graderCases.body:
MortgageLoan m = new MortgageLoan(100000.0,0.03,2000.0);
eqD(m.calculateTotalRepayment(30),100000.0 + 100000.0*0.03*30 + 2000.0 - 1000.0);

graderCases.name: monthlyPayment spreads total over months

questions.title: Mars Rover Controller
questions.prompt:
This capstone requires a question-specific abstract class **and** a question-specific interface, extended/implemented together by your concrete class.

Create an abstract class `Rover` in `Rover.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String roverId`, `int battery`, `int samples`.
* **Constructor:** `Rover(String roverId)` starts at `battery = 100`, `samples = 0`.
* **Getters:** `getBattery()`, `getSamples()`.
* Method `isDead()`: returns `true` when `battery <= 0`.
* Method `recharge(int percent)`: add `percent` to `battery`, **capped at 100**.
* **Abstract method:** `public abstract boolean collectSample();`

Create an interface `PowerManaged` in `PowerManaged.java`:
* Abstract method: `int batteryLevel();`
* Abstract method: `int minimumOperatingLevel();`
* Default method: `default boolean canOperate()`: returns `true` when `batteryLevel() >= minimumOperatingLevel()`.
* Default method: `default int reserve()`: `batteryLevel() - minimumOperatingLevel()`, but **never negative** (floored at `0`).

Create a class `ScienceRover` in `ScienceRover.java` **extending `Rover` and implementing `PowerManaged`**:
* **Constructor:** `ScienceRover(String roverId)` calling `super`.
* `batteryLevel()` returns the current battery.
* `minimumOperatingLevel()` returns `25` (the cost of one drill).
* `collectSample()`: if `battery < 25`, **refuse** — return `false` and change nothing. Otherwise deduct `25` battery, add `1` sample, and return `true`.

*Edge cases to think about (not in the sample): `recharge` must cap at 100; drilling at exactly 25% succeeds and leaves 0% (then `isDead()` is true); a refused drill must not change battery or sample count; `reserve()` must never go negative.*
questions.expectedOutput:
Drilled: true
Battery: 75% | Samples: 1
After recharge: 100%

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Collect a sample, then recharge capped at 100.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Recharge Cap)
tests.description: Recharging above 100 caps at 100.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Drill Refused Under 25%)
tests.description: A refused drill returns false and leaves battery and samples unchanged.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Exact 25% Drills to 0)
tests.description: Drilling with exactly 25% succeeds, lands on 0%, and isDead() becomes true.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (canOperate Threshold)
tests.description: canOperate is true at or above the minimum operating level, false below.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Reserve Non-Negative)
tests.description: reserve never returns a negative value.

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Fresh Rover State)
tests.description: A new rover starts at 100% battery, 0 samples, not dead.
